Real responses, captured 2026-10-18 from gemini.google.com and kept as they came.

- `hello-conversation.json`: the decoded `hNvQHb` answer for a one-turn chat
  ("Reply with just the word: hello", Gemini 3.1 Pro). Checked against the live
  response by length and hash when it was saved.
- `usage-pro.json`, `usage-free.json`: the decoded `jSf9Qc` answers for a Google
  AI Pro account and a free one.

Turns with Deep Research documents and uploaded files are built in the suites from
the shapes recorded in `src/content/conversation.js`, because the real ones carry
personal content.
